description:
Requested by Tob.

The very laid-back theme from the Underground Stage of Kirby Tilt 'n Tumble. This could be used both as a cave stage theme and as a bonus theme, once again, it's up to you to what scenario you think is best

Also, be careful with some of SFX, because they don't seem to work too well due to the noise channel being used here
